note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 6.2 ("If one of the Optional Parameters in the OPEN message is not recognized, then the Error Subcode MUST be set to Unsupported Optional Parameters."). TestSessionRFC4271OptionalParameterErrors drives a live OpenSent Session over net.Pipe: positive sends unknown Optional Parameter type 99 ([99, 0]) and asserts ReadAndProcess errors, exact NOTIFICATION [2, 4] on the socket, and FSM transition to StateIdle; negative sends unknown capability 200 inside recognized Type 2 ([2, 2, 200, 0]) and asserts KEEPALIVE and StateOpenConfirm per RFC 5492 Section 3.
